Data Schematic
Description:This dataset provides a comprehensive collection of motor vehicle crash records in Pennsylvania, spanning the years 1997 through 2020. It encompasses temporal data such as the year, month, day of the week, and hour of occurrence, alongside geographic information including county names and urban/rural classifications. The records detail environmental conditions like weather, illumination, and road surface status at the time of the incident. Additionally, the dataset captures specific collision types, contributing factors such as alcohol or speeding, and critical outcome statistics including counts of fatalities, injuries, persons, and vehicles involved. This information serves as a robust resource for analyzing traffic safety trends and accident patterns across different demographics and environments.
